bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsdv_mu_land #(.W(1104), .NB(80), .NS(1), .SRAM(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/dsdv_mu_land.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_land/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_land/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/dsdv_mu_land --out {RUN}/record/views/dsdv_mu_land --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: MU-S81/KIT 10-19: NEW leaf dsdv_mu_land (MU-S81/LINK 0e11a04bb, results/rtl/mu_s81_link_1018/README.md): the second h landing of an MU end-slice link endpoint (owner MU.DECIDE option A), NS 1 x NB 80 x 1,104 b in 5 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 (88,320 b), static land / replay, sticky faults, no ready / credit. Sits N of the lep (s81sl_lepmu N face = ml_wv / ml_wd / ml_rv / ml_rd / ml_f), so every port is on the S face: 2,226 pins on 475.2 um (4.68/um, lep width). Macros (W/E data pins) in two rows (3 + 2) >= 64.8 um from the pin face, >= 30 um channels; S band holds the 2.2k wd / rd / rc pin flops. Clock: 8 region roots by 2-D k-means (clock_split_km.tcl, as s81sl_xr1 / s81sl_lep).
